build_sinq_quantizer: build a SinqHfQuantizer instance with SinqConfig for weight-only SINQ quantization of a pretrained model
validate_sinq_environment: validate the environment for SINQ quantization including sinq package availability and single GPU device support
build_sinq_quant_dict: build the quantization configuration dict that SINQLinear expects from an SinqConfig
replace_model_with_sinq_linear: replace nn.Linear modules in a pretrained model with SINQLinear modules before weight loading
patch_hf_save_load_for_sinq: patch HuggingFace save and load methods to support SINQ model serialization after weight loading
